name: placeholders-and-vanish-input
title: Vanish Placeholder Input
blurb: Input with rotating placeholder text and a canvas particle dissolve animation…
description: An input field with cycling placeholder suggestions that change every 3 seconds, and a canvas-based particle animation when submitted that dissolves the text into vanishing particles.
use_when: Creating interactive prompt or search interfaces where animated text effects and placeholder cycling enhance engagement.
avoid_when: On devices where canvas animations impact performance or when prefers-reduced-motion compliance is needed.
a11y: Input is semantic, submit button is disabled when empty, but the particle animation does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
